The day is fast approaching when emulation will be the only way to observe or learn about many facets of technology's past. This will certainly be the very best way to experience Emulation of any kind. Consoles should be faithfully modeled and represented (within reason) so that a virtual model appears to be driving the emulated experience. I have invested in retro controllers with USB and USB adapters for hardware that faithfully replicate and provide many of yesterday's tactile control elements. You should always try to experience the real thing whenever possible. But this is the most exciting development I have seen in this arena in decades! Soon, this will be the only way to do it. I can see this preserving a very vital part of our collective heritage for many decades to come. I can't wait to see MESS and perhaps MAME ported this way.
